title: Holographic Shape Transition
description: An additive holographic projection whose silhouette is carried entirely by a squared Fresnel rim with grazing falloff, banded by footprint-filtered object-space scanlines, jittered by a height-phased glitch gate, and handed shape to shape by one shared vertical sweep with complementary discards.
techniques: squared Fresnel rim with grazing falloff
shared normalised sweep range across a shape set
complementary discard handover under additive blending
